entities.summary: Song, a notable figure in the history of Hong Kong, associated with Prehistoric and Ancient Hong Kong (200 BCE–1514). Preceded by Imperial Chinese Periphery and Neolithic and Bronze Age Settlement. Their legacy influenced Canton Trade System.
